rationale: The agent made several tool calls (found the user, fetched user details and two orders, and then modified the address), but the conversation shows no disclosure of the requested information (shipment address used, tracking numbers, transit status, or tablet storage). Critically, the agent performed a write action (modifying the default address) without first confirming with the user, which violates the policy’s requirement to confirm before writes. Authentication was minimal (name+ZIP lookup) and not explicitly confirmed with the user. The final message abruptly ends the interaction without providing the requested details or engaging as requested. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy and outcome quality is insufficient.
